scope: Local production build; north and south overviews, north detail refinement and lighting toggle
rootCause: Heightmap polar tiles supplied no normals under a provider advertising vertex normals; separate polar mosaic and hard 80-degree cutoff also produced inconsistent visual coverage.
fix: Quantized meshes with oct-encoded relief normals, stable pole normals and geographic UV coverage; orthographic QuickMap imagery blended from 60 to 65 degrees latitude; versioned image caches.
limitations: Tiles refine progressively and require upstream service availability.
Numerical terrain horizons and JPL analysis were not changed by this rendering fix.
